info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce REST API
info.description:
Core REST API for accessing Salesforce objects and data. Provides CRUD operations on standard and custom objects, query execution via SOQL, search via SOSL, and metadata access used as the foundation for Experience Cloud data integrations.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support
